一剑斩龙天地肃满朝风雨从此生（一剑斩龙天地肃满朝风雨从此生（第22页）这位水部部长从方才苏元踹门进来到现在，便僵在椅子上，一句话都没说。苏元转过身，大步朝门外走去。路过余庆身边时，他脚下不停，只丢下一句话。“余庆，回部里开会。”云路之上，一百二十名力士连押带抗，带着三条老龙当先而行，一个个精神抖擞，胸脯挺得老高。有几个年轻力士还在偷偷交换眼神，脸上的红潮还没褪干净，手脚都在兴奋地发抖，显然还没从方才那番阵仗中回过神来。唯独余庆，与这满队的昂扬气象格格不入。他与苏元并肩走在队伍最后，脸上的神色说不上难看，却也绝不好看。走了一阵，他忽然开口了。“苏元。”苏元“嗯”了一声，没回头。“是不是太冲动了？”苏元脚步一顿，偏过头来，看着余庆。余庆见他停了步，连忙又补了一句：“当然，我不是说这几条龙拿得不对。这几条龙犯了天条不说，还公然拒捕、袭击雷部执法人员，死了也是白死。”“我的意思是，走之前，好歹也给鲁雄一个台阶下不是？毕竟人家也是水部正印，当着满堂司属的面，咱们一脚踹开大门，拿了人就扬长而去，连句话都不给人家留。”“这……这传出去，往后雷部跟水部还怎么共事？”苏元听完，没有立刻回答。他转过身，负手站在云路边缘，望着脚下翻涌的云海，沉默了好一会儿。然后，他冷笑一声。“我给他台阶？我欠他的？”“鲁雄自己愿意当孙子，愿意在自家衙门里给几条挂职的老龙端茶倒水，那是他自己的事。”“他自己性子软，骨头酥，喜欢给人家当晚辈，那就别怪我也来踩一脚。”“这世道就这样，你先把腰弯了，就别怪人家骑到你脖子上。”他转过身来，看着余庆，目光平静如水。“更何况，他水部开会，让我们雷部副部长坐在最角落里，连张像样的椅子都没有。他给过你台阶么？他给过雷部台阶么？”余庆沉默了。他上下打量着苏元，像是在看一个不太认识的人。当年苏元第一次进雷部，还是自己亲手抓进去的，后来苏元在雷部当处长、当司长的时候，他是都苏元的顶头上司。那时候的苏元，圆滑，老练，未语先笑，八面玲珑，见人说人话，见鬼说鬼话。别说是动刀动枪，便是跟同僚之间，重话也不怎么说。不管对上对下，永远是那副笑呵呵的模样，让人如沐春风。可方才那番话，字字带刀，句句见血，哪里有半分从前那个苏元的影子？他正要说点什么，崇应鸾从前头小跑着回来了。“大人。”“这次动静不小。三条老龙，一死一伤一拿，又是水部正堂，又是天河禁地，又是诛仙四剑重新现世。属下加的好几个群都在议论。恐怕朝堂还会再起风波……”苏元摆了摆手。“如今朝堂的风波还小么？”崇应鸾愣了一下，便听苏元继续道：“阐教截教水火不容，分管帝君不知所踪，广成子虎视眈眈，陛下又要励精图治。这朝堂上上下下、里里外外，哪一处不是风波？哪一天不是风波？”“如今雷部尾大不掉，积弊丛生。截教抱团，阐教搅局，两边斗了几百年，正事没人干，歪事一箩筐。都想当老好人，谁也不得罪，结果呢？连他妈一个水文会商都被人骑到头上拉屎。”“这种局面，不来一场大风波，不来一场大地震，怎么凝聚人心？怎么刮骨疗毒？”云路尽头，雷部大堂的轮廓已隐隐在望。

Chapter 666: Killing the Dragon with One Sword, Heaven and Earth Sustained, Full of Wind and Rain (Page 1)
Kill the dragon with one sword, and the world will be filled with solemnity, and the world will be full of wind and rain from now on (Page 22) The Minister of Water Resources has been frozen in his chair since Su Yuan kicked in the door just now, and has not said a word. . Su Yuan turned around and strode towards the door. When he passed by Yu Qing, he kept walking and said only one sentence: "Yu Qing, go back to the ministry for a meeting." On the cloud road, one hundred and twenty strong men were escorted and led by three men. An old dragon was leading the way, all in high spirits, with their chests high. Several young warriors were still secretly exchanging glances. The redness on their faces had not yet faded away, and their hands and feet were shaking with excitement. It was obvious that they had not recovered from what they had just seen. After coming back to his senses during the battle, Yu Qing was the only one who was incompatible with the high-spirited atmosphere of the entire team. He walked side by side with Su Yuan at the end of the team. The look on his face was not ugly, but he was definitely not good-looking after walking for a while. "Su Yuan." Su Yuan said "yes" and didn't look back. "Are you too impulsive?" Su Yuan paused and turned his head to look at Yu Qing. Seeing him stop, Yu Qing quickly added: "Of course, I'm not saying that these dragons were wrong. Not to mention, these dragons openly resisted arrest and attacked the law enforcement officers of the Lei Department. Their death was in vain." "I mean, before leaving, give Lu Xiong a chance. After all, he is also the official seal of the Ministry of Water. In front of the whole hall, we kicked the door open, took the person and walked away without leaving a word. ""If this... spreads out, how will the Ministry of Lei and the Ministry of Water work together in the future?" After hearing this, Su Yuan did not answer immediately. He turned around and stood on the edge of the cloud road with his hands behind his hands, looking at the sea of clouds under his feet. He was silent for a long time. Then he sneered. What do I owe him?" "It's his own business if Lu Xiong is willing to be a grandson and to serve some old dragons in his yamen." If you're a junior, don't blame me for stepping on you. ""That's the way the world is. If you bend down first, don't blame others for riding on your neck." He turned around and looked at Yu Qing, his eyes as calm as water. "What's more. During the meeting of the Water Department, we, the deputy director of the Lei Department, were not even given a decent chair. Did he give you steps? Did he give the Lei Department steps? "Yu Qing was silent. He looked at Su Yuan up and down, as if he was looking at someone he didn't know. When Su Yuan first entered the Lei Department, he was arrested by himself. Later, when Su Yuan was the director and director of the Lei Department, he was Du Su Yuan's immediate boss. Yuan, smooth and sophisticated, smiles before saying anything, is smart in dealing with people, and speaks nonsense to everyone, not to mention using swords and guns, even when talking to colleagues, he always smiles like that. Hehe looked like a breath of fresh air. But what he said just now was full of blood, and there was no trace of the former Su Yuan. When he was about to say something, Chong Yingluan came trotting back from the front. "There's a lot of movement this time. One of them is dead, one is injured, and the other is the Tianhe Forbidden Area, and the Four Swords of Killing Immortals have reappeared. I'm afraid the court will still be talking about it." Another turmoil..." Su Yuan waved his hand. "Is the turmoil in the court still small now?" Chong Yingluan was stunned for a moment, and then Su Yuan continued: "The emperor in charge is nowhere to be found, and Guangchengzi is watching.Ai, your majesty will work hard again. Up and down, inside and outside the court, where is it that is not a storm? Which day is not a storm? "Nowadays, the Lei Department is unable to get rid of its tail, and there are many disadvantages. Jie Jiao joined forces, and Chan Jiao disrupted the situation. The two sides have been fighting for hundreds of years, with no one doing the right things and a lot of crooked things. We all want to be good guys and don’t offend anyone, but what’s the result? Even a fucking hydrological consultation was ridiculed. "In this situation, if there is no big storm or a big earthquake, how can we unite people's hearts?" How to scrape bones to treat poison? "At the end of Yun Road, the outline of the Lei Department Hall is faintly visible.
